name: Inoue Genzaburou
source:
President of Inoue Construction, and also the "cafeteria uncle" at Hakuou Academy.
He is an old acquaintance of [url=/c14794]Kondou[/url]'s, and has provided all kinds of assistance since the academy's founding up to the present day.
translation:
President of Inoue Construction, and also the "cafeteria uncle" at Hakuou Academy.
He is an old acquaintance of [url=/c14794]Kondou[/url]'s, and has provided all kinds of assistance since the academy's founding up to the present day.
